items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec (UK only). One for your bass bins: dubstep legend Coki enters the Sweatbox for Halloween, providing 30 minutes of head-rattling bass music. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Coki

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec (UK only). SHERELLE gets spooky for Halloween, playing the deepest, darkest dubstep in her arsenal! Expect tunes from Mala, multiple appearances from Kahn and Joker, with some haunting sounds along the way... Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: It's Halloween! Let's Listen To Dubstep!

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Nov (UK only). BRIT and MOBO-nominated artist Eliza Rose closes out the Black History Month series in the Sweatbox, with 30 minutes of her favourite UK garage bangers. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Eliza Rose

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Nov (UK only). In this all-out celebration of the women of UK garage, Kele Le Roc gets in the Cab to the Club, selecting three tracks she wants to hear en-route to the rave. Elsewhere in the show, SHERELLE's celebrating the often unsung female vocalists, producers and DJs within the genre, with a contributing voice note from Eliza Rose and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Celebrating the women of UK garage

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Nov (UK only). Jumpin Jack Frost closes out the show with 30 minutes of full-force jungle. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Jumpin Jack Frost

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Nov (UK only). SHERELLE is joined by jungle pioneer Jumpin Jack Frost to talk dubplates and the incredible journey of his track Burial. Together, they discuss how soundsystem culture is at the heart of jungle, and how dubplates were an essential part of any set in order to test out new material and set them apart from other DJs. They also discuss how the story of Burial has evolved even further, with brand new remixes from Todd Terry, Supa D and more. Elsewhere in the show, SHERELLE plays jungle tracks that were originally dubplates from Dillinja, D’Cruze and Congo Natt…
items.title: Dubplate culture and jungle with Jumpin Jack Frost

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 10 Nov (UK only). DJ and producer Fiyahdred ramps up the vibe in the Sweatbox with UK club energy, mixing tracks from their favourite Black producers.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Fiyahdred

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 10 Nov (UK only). SHERELLE focuses on the theme of 'ragga' - what does it mean, and where does it come from? With a playlist of reggae, dancehall and jungle, SHERELLE weaves her way through some of the music associated with this historied term. Along the way, she plays tracks from Lady Saw, Shabba Ranks, Beenie Man, Sasha and some of her favourite artists defining the ‘ragga’ sound.
items.title: 'Ragga'
